).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 1, '') AS all_subjects FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = (t.user_code = #{userCode} OR #{userCode} = 'all') AND cc.class_type IN ('1', '2') GROUP BY ta.student_id ), manualPayments AS ( SELECT payment_key, SUM(card_amount + cash_amount + transfer_amount + CASE WHEN tbp.total_bill_price = 0 THEN 'discount' WHEN #{itemType} = 'EDU_FEE' THEN CASE WHEN p.status = 'pending' AND COALESCE(mp.manual_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 'nonIssue_off' WHEN p.status = 'pending' THEN 'nonIssue' WHEN lb.status = 'destroyed' AND COALESCE(mp.manual_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 'destroyed_off' WHEN lb.status = 'destroyed' THEN 'destroyed' WHEN lb.status = 'canceled' AND COALESCE(mp.manual_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 'canceled_off' WHEN lb.status = 'canceled' THEN 'canceled' ELSE 'issued' END ELSE CASE WHEN lb.bill_id IS NULL THEN 'nonIssue' WHEN lb.status = 'destroyed' THEN 'destroyed' WHEN lb.status = 'canceled' THEN 'canceled' ELSE 'issued' END END AS issuanceStatus,
pa.parent_tel_first + pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last AS parentPhone,
NULLIF( STUFF(( SELECT ', ' + s2.student_name FROM erp_student s2 LEFT JOIN erp_parent pa2 ON s2.student_id = pa2.student_id WHERE pa2.parent_tel_first = pa.parent_tel_first AND pa2.parent_tel_middle = pa.parent_tel_middle AND pa2.parent_tel_last = pa.parent_tel_last AND s2.student_id != b.student_id AND s2.center_code = #{centerCode} AND s2.status_key NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN') FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, ''), '') AS samePhoneStudents,
CASE WHEN #{itemType} = 'EDU_FEE' AND sf.standard_edu_fee IS NOT NULL AND sf.standard_edu_fee > 0 AND tbp.total_bill_price != sf.standard_edu_fee THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isPriceModified,
sf.standard_edu_fee AS standardFee
FROM base b LEFT JOIN allClassInfo aci ON b.student_id = aci.student_id LEFT JOIN standardFees sf ON b.student_id = sf.student_id JOIN erp_payment p ON b.payment_key = p.payment_key LEFT JOIN erp_parent pa ON b.student_id = pa.student_id LEFT JOIN latestBill lb ON b.payment_key = lb.payment_key LEFT JOIN manualPayments mp ON b.payment_key = mp.payment_key LEFT JOIN approvedBills ab ON b.payment_key = ab.payment_key LEFT JOIN totalBillByPayment tbp ON b.payment_key = tbp.payment_key
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN #{userCode} != 'all' THEN STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ',' + u2.user_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON ta2.time_table_key = t2.time_table_key JOIN erp_user u2 ON t2.user_code = u2.user_code WHERE ta2.student_id = b.student_id AND t2.yy = #{year} AND t2.mm = #{month} AND t2.center_code = #{centerCode} AND t2.user_code != #{userCode} FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 1, '') END AS other_teachers,

CASE WHEN #{userCode} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ( SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CAST(s.is_hoho AS TINYINT)) = 1 THEN 'hoho' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN cc2.class_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'han' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN cc2.class_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'book' ELSE NULL END FROM erp_time_table_assign ta4 JOIN erp_time_table t4 ON ta4.time_table_key = t4.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON t4.class_key = cc2.class_key JOIN erp_student s ON ta4.student_id = s.student_id WHERE ta4.student_id = b.student_id AND t4.yy = #{year} AND t4.mm = #{month} AND t4.center_code = #{centerCode} AND t4.user_code != #{userCode} ) END AS other_subject_type ) oc

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_payment_callback (bill_id, api_key, appr_cat_id, appr_pay_type, appr_card_type, appr_date, appr_issuer, appr_issuer_code, appr_issuer_num, appr_num, appr_price, appr_state, appr_monthly, appr_acquirer_code, appr_acquirer_name, appr_origin_date, appr_origin_num, created_at) VALUES (#{billId}, #{apiKey}, #{apprCatId}, #{apprPayType}, #{apprCardType}, #{apprDate}, #{apprIssuer}, #{apprIssuerCode}, #{apprIssuerNum}, #{apprNum}, #{apprPrice}, #{apprState}, #{apprMonthly}, #{apprAcquirerCode}, #{apprAcquirerName}, #{apprOriginDate}, #{apprOriginNum}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_payment_bill b ON p.payment_key = b.payment_key WHERE b.bill_id = #{billId}

SELECT TOP 16 * FROM (select ep.id, ep.yy + '-' + ep.mm as inym, 'I' as gb, SUBSTRING(epc.appr_date, 0, 9) as indate, status as state, ep.amount as inmoney, CASE WHEN ep.bill_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN 'S' WHEN ep.bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE' THEN 'B' END AS gubun from erp_payment_bill ep join erp_payment_callback epc on ep.bill_id = epc.bill_id where student_id = #{studentId}) AS combined ORDER BY combined.id desc;

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN pd.amount END) AS amount, pa.parent_tel_first + pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last AS phoneNumber
FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_payment_detail pd ON p.payment_key = pd.payment_key JOIN erp_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON ta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON ta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code JOIN erp_parent pa ON s.student_id = pa.student_id WHERE p.center_code = #{centerCode} AND p.yy = #{yy} AND p.mm = #{mm} AND p.status IN ('issued', 'pending', 'partial') GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, p.payment_key, g.grade_name, hu.user_name, bu.user_name, pa.parent_tel_first + pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN pd.amount END) > 0;

SELECT pb.id, pb.payment_key, pb.bill_id, pb.bill_type, pb.amount, pb.student_id, pb.center_code, pb.status, pb.created_at, pb.issued_date, pb.yy, pb.mm FROM erp_payment_bill pb JOIN (SELECT payment_key, bill_type FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE status = 'issued' GROUP BY payment_key, bill_type HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) d ON pb.payment_key = d.payment_key AND pb.bill_type = d.bill_type WHERE pb.status = 'issued' AND pb.created_at < (SELECT MAX(x.created_at) FROM erp_payment_bill x WHERE x.payment_key = pb.payment_key AND x.bill_type = pb.bill_type) ORDER BY pb.payment_key, pb.bill_type, pb.created_at;
SELECT * FROM erp_card_code where use_yn = '1'

select pm.id, s.student_name, pm.paid_date, pm.payment_key, pm.cash_amount as cash, pm.card_amount as card, pm.transfer_amount as trasfer, epc.appr_cash_num from erp_payment_manual pm join erp_payment_manual_group pmg on pm.manual_key = pmg.manual_key join erp_student s on pm.student_id = s.student_id left join erp_payment_cashbill epc on pmg.cashbill_id = epc.bill_id where pmg.center_code = #{centerCode} and pm.yy = #{yy} and pm.mm = #{mm}
SELECT SUM(amount) as amount FROM erp_payment_detail where payment_key = #{paymentKey} AND item_type = 'EDU_FEE'

SELECT bill_id AS billId, bill_type AS billType FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE bill_id IN
#{billId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_bill WHERE bill_id = #{billId} AND status = 'REISSUED'
SELECT * FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE expire_date = #{ymd} AND status = 'issued'

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, pm.payment_key AS paymentKey, s.student_name AS studentName, g.grade_name AS gradeName, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher, (pm.cash_amount + pm.transfer_amount) as amount, (pa.parent_tel_first + pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last) as phoneNumber FROM erp_payment_manual_group pmg JOIN erp_payment_manual pm on pmg.manual_key = pm.manual_key JOIN erp_student s ON pmg.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign eta ON s.student_id = eta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON eta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON eta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_parent pa ON s.student_id = pa.student_id WHERE pm.yy = #{yy} AND pm.mm = #{mm} AND s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND pmg.[method] IN ('CASH', 'TRANSFER') AND pmg.cashbill_id is null ORDER BY s.student_name;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_payment_cashbill (bill_id, payment_key, student_id, receipt_type, receipt_number, trader, price, supply_price, tax, tax_type, appr_cash_num, hash_value, status, issue_date, created_at) VALUES (#{billId}, #{paymentKey}, #{studentId}, #{receiptType}, #{receiptNumber}, #{trader}, #{price}, #{supplyPrice}, #{tax}, #{taxType}, #{apprCashNum}, #{hashValue}, #{status}, #{issueDate}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_payment_manual_group SET cashbill_id = #{cashbillId}, cashbill_issued_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE manual_key = #{manualKey}
mapper.select: SELECT cash.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, cash.payment_key AS paymentKey, cash.bill_id AS billId, cash.appr_cash_num AS apprNum, cash.issue_date AS issueDate, cash.receipt_type AS receiptType, cash.price AS price, cash.supply_price AS supplyPrice, cash.tax AS taxPrice, cash.status AS status FROM erp_payment_cashbill cash JOIN erp_payment p on cash.payment_key = p.payment_key JOIN erp_student s on cash.student_id = s.student_id where p.center_code = #{centerCode} AND p.yy = #{year} AND p.mm = #{month} ORDER BY cash.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_payment_cashbill SET status = #{status}, cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancelled_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE bill_id = #{billId}
mapper.select: WITH base AS (SELECT s.student_id, p.payment_key, s.student_name, pd.item_type, SUM(pd.amount) AS billPrice FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_payment p ON s.student_id = p.student_id JOIN erp_payment_detail pd ON p.payment_key = pd.payment_key AND ta.time_table_key = pd.time_table_key WHERE t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND t.center_code = #{centerCode} AND pd.item_type IN ('EDU_FEE', 'BOOK_FEE') AND p.status NOT IN ('pending') GROUP BY s.student_id, p.payment_key, s.student_name, pd.item_type), manualPayments AS (SELECT payment_key, SUM(card_amount + cash_amount + transfer_amount) AS manual_amount FROM erp_payment_manual GROUP BY payment_key), approvedBills AS (SELECT payment_key, bill_type, SUM(amount) AS bill_amount FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE status = 'approved' AND bill_type IN ('EDU_FEE', 'BOOK_FEE') GROUP BY payment_key, bill_type) SELECT b.student_id AS studentId, b.student_name AS studentName, pa.parent_tel_first + pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last AS parentPhone, SUM(CASE WHEN b.billPrice - ( CASE WHEN b.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN COALESCE(mp.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE(ab.bill_amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(ab.bill_amount, 0) END) > 0 THEN b.billPrice - ( CASE WHEN b.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN COALESCE(mp.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE(ab.bill_amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(ab.bill_amount, 0) END) ELSE 0 END) AS totalUnpaidAmount, b.payment_key AS paymentKey FROM base b LEFT JOIN erp_parent pa ON b.student_id = pa.student_id LEFT JOIN manualPayments mp ON b.payment_key = mp.payment_key LEFT JOIN approvedBills ab ON b.payment_key = ab.payment_key AND b.item_type = ab.bill_type GROUP BY b.student_id, b.payment_key, b.student_name, pa.parent_tel_first, pa.parent_tel_middle, pa.parent_tel_last, mp.manual_amount HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN b.billPrice - ( CASE WHEN b.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN COALESCE(mp.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE(ab.bill_amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(ab.bill_amount, 0) END) > 0 THEN b.billPrice - ( CASE WHEN b.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN COALESCE(mp.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE(ab.bill_amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(ab.bill_amount, 0) END) ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY b.student_name

SELECT id, manual_key AS manualKey, center_code AS centerCode, student_id AS studentId, paid_date AS paidDate, payment_key AS paymentKey, cash_amount AS cashAmount, card_amount AS cardAmount, transfer_amount AS transferAmount, card_name AS cardName FROM erp_payment_manual WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, manual_key AS manualKey, student_id AS studentId FROM erp_payment_manual WHERE manual_key = #{manualKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_payment_manual SET paid_date = #{dto.paidDate}, card_amount = #{dto.cardAmount}, cash_amount = #{dto.cashAmount}, transfer_amount = #{dto.transferAmount}, card_name = #{dto.cardName} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WITH student_subjects AS (SELECT DISTINCT pc.appr_cash_num, pc.student_id, s.student_name, CASE cc.class_type WHEN 1 THEN '한자' WHEN 2 THEN '독서' END AS subject_name FROM erp_payment_cashbill pc JOIN erp_payment p ON pc.payment_key = p.payment_key JOIN erp_student s ON pc.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key AND t.yy + '-' + t.mm = #{ym} LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key AND cc.class_type IN (1, 2) WHERE p.yy + '-' + p.mm = #{ym} AND s.center_code = #{centerCode}), student_display AS (SELECT DISTINCT appr_cash_num, student_id, -- 과목 정보가 없으면 이름만 표시 student_name + ISNULL( NULLIF( '(' + STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + ss2.subject_name FROM student_subjects ss2 WHERE ss2.appr_cash_num = ss.appr_cash_num AND ss2.student_id = ss.student_id AND ss2.subject_name IS NOT NULL FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') + ')', '()') , '') AS student_display FROM student_subjects ss) SELECT STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + sd.student_display FROM student_display sd WHERE sd.appr_cash_num = pc.appr_cash_num FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS studentInfo, MAX(pc.bill_id) AS billId, MAX(pc.created_at) AS apprDate, MAX(pc.receipt_number) AS receiptNum, pc.appr_cash_num AS apprCashNum, MAX(pc.supply_price) AS supplyPrice, MAX(pc.tax) AS taxPrice, MAX(pc.price) AS totalPrice, MAX(c.biz_name) AS centerName, MAX(c.director_name) AS directorName, MAX(c.biz_no) AS bizNo, MAX(c.center_tel) AS centerTel, MAX(c.center_address) AS centerAddress FROM erp_payment_cashbill pc JOIN erp_payment p ON pc.payment_key = p.payment_key JOIN erp_student s ON pc.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_center c ON s.center_code = c.center_code WHERE p.yy + '-' + p.mm = #{ym} AND s.center_code = #{centerCode} GROUP BY pc.appr_cash_num ORDER BY MAX(pc.created_at) DESC

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.billing_phone AS phone, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, s.sub_hoho AS subHoho, s.sub_han AS subHan, s.sub_book AS subBook, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(pb.amount) FROM erp_payment_bill pb WHERE pb.student_id = s.student_id AND pb.bill_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND pb.status = 'issued' AND pb.yy + pb.mm NOT IN (#{ym}) AND s.center_code = #{centerCode}), 0) AS arrears, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(pd.amount) FROM erp_payment_detail pd JOIN erp_payment p2 ON p.payment_key = pd.payment_key WHERE p2.yy + p2.mm = #{ym} AND pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND p2.student_id = s.student_id), 0) AS tuition, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(pd.amount) FROM erp_payment_detail pd JOIN erp_payment p2 ON p2.payment_key = pd.payment_key WHERE p2.yy + p2.mm = #{ym} AND pd.item_type = 'BOOK_FEE' AND p2.student_id = s.student_id), 0) AS textbookFee, ISNULL((SELECT CASE WHEN pb.status = 'approved' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM erp_payment_bill pb WHERE pb.student_id = s.student_id AND pb.yy + pb.mm = #{ym} AND pb.bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE' AND pb.bill_id = (SELECT MAX(pb2.bill_id) FROM erp_payment_bill pb2 WHERE pb2.student_id = s.student_id AND pb2.yy + pb2.mm = #{ym} AND pb2.bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE')), 'false') AS textbookPaid FROM erp_student s LEFT JOIN erp_payment p on s.student_id = p.student_id AND p.yy + p.mm = #{ym} WHERE (student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR REPLACE(billing_phone, '-', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND s.status_key = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_payment p WHERE p.student_id = s.student_id AND p.yy + p.mm = #{ym} AND p.status = 'approved') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_payment_manual pm WHERE pm.student_id = s.student_id AND pm.yy + pm.mm = '202605');
SELECT student_id FROM erp_sibling WHERE sibling_key = (SELECT sibling_key FROM erp_sibling WHERE student_id = #{studentId}) AND student_id != #{studentId}

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.billing_phone AS phone, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, s.sub_hoho AS subHoho, s.sub_han AS subHan, s.sub_book AS subBook, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(pb.amount) FROM erp_payment_bill pb WHERE pb.student_id = s.student_id AND pb.bill_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND pb.status = 'issued' AND pb.yy + pb.mm NOT IN (#{ym}) AND s.center_code = #{centerCode}), 0) AS arrears, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(pd.amount) FROM erp_payment_detail pd JOIN erp_payment p2 ON p2.payment_key = pd.payment_key WHERE p2.yy + p2.mm = #{ym} AND pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND p2.student_id = s.student_id), 0) AS tuition, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(pd.amount) FROM erp_payment_detail pd JOIN erp_payment p2 ON p2.payment_key = pd.payment_key WHERE p2.yy + p2.mm = #{ym} AND pd.item_type = 'BOOK_FEE' AND p2.student_id = s.student_id), 0) AS textbookFee, ISNULL((SELECT CASE WHEN pb.status = 'approved' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM erp_payment_bill pb WHERE pb.student_id = s.student_id AND pb.yy + pb.mm = #{ym} AND pb.bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE' AND pb.bill_id = (SELECT MAX(pb2.bill_id) FROM erp_payment_bill pb2 WHERE pb2.student_id = s.student_id AND pb2.yy + pb2.mm = #{ym} AND pb2.bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE')), 'false') AS textbookPaid FROM erp_student s LEFT JOIN erp_payment p on s.student_id = p.student_id AND p.yy + p.mm = #{ym} WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} AND s.center_code = #{centerCode}
